data.text: The SoA described below should be followed for all participants enrolled in Study J1I-MC-GZBY (GZBY). However, for those participants whose participation in this study is affected by exceptional circumstances, such as pandemics or natural disasters, please refer to Section 10.14 for additional guidance.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities (SoA)

data.text: Visit procedures may be conducted over more than 1 day if all activities are completed within the allowed visit tolerance period of each visit.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities - Visit Details

data.text: On all fasting visits, study participants are required to report to the site in a fasting condition, after at least 8 hours without eating, drinking (except water), or performing any significant physical activity. Additionally, the participant should not take their study intervention before the fasting visit. If a participant is adversely affected by the fasting condition, they are allowed to eat; however, specific study procedures need to be completed while fasting.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities - Fasting Visits

data.text: If a participant attends a fasting visit in the non-fasting state, reschedule the visit at a time within the allowable visit interval.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities - Fasting Visits

data.text: Visit 2 may occur as soon as the criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed. At Visit 2, screening laboratory results will be reviewed to confirm eligibility. Visit 3 to occur no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities - Screening Visits

data.text: The only procedure performed for these visits is PK sample collection.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities - PK Only Visits

data.text: For early discontinuation that occurs before the last visit in treatment period, see the activities listed for ED in the SoA.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities - Early Discontinuation Visit

data.text: A posttreatment safety follow-up visit will occur approximately 4 weeks following the last treatment period visit. Participants who have discontinued study intervention early and are only willing to come back for Visit 11 (Week 40) are not required to complete a safety follow-up visit if they have been off of study intervention for at least 28 days (see Section 7.1.1).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities - Visit 801 (Safety Follow-up Period)

data.text: Unscheduled visits may occur as needed.

data.text: Overall rationale for the amendment: add new AESI of 'malnutrition and inadequate fluid intake' and update the title and text for AESI of 'ketoacidosis due to inadequate nutritional intake and other types of metabolic acidosis and ketosis'; provide more detailed guidance on recommending, monitoring, and managing nutritional intake and hydration; update criteria for dose modification; and include adjudication of urgent visit for heart failure.
data.sourceSection: Protocol Amendment Summary of Changes Table

data.text: Added a note in Inclusion Criterion 8 to address the usage of gender-neutral terms (AMAB and AFAB) in the document. For clarification and consistency with TRANSCEND T2D protocols.
data.sourceSection: Amendment Summary - Section 5.1 Inclusion Criteria

data.text: Removed the word 'clinically significant' from Exclusion Criterion 22. Clarification to avoid ambiguity.
data.sourceSection: Amendment Summary - Section 5.2 Exclusion Criteria

data.text: Defined study intervention in Exclusion Criterion 36 as retatrutide, placebo, or an active comparator. Clarification.
data.sourceSection: Amendment Summary - Section 5.2 Exclusion Criteria

data.text: Updated calcitonin units from 'ng/L' to 'pg/mL (Conventional) and pmol/L (SI)' in Exclusion Criterion 24 and in Section 8.3.3.8. To align with central lab reporting.
data.sourceSection: Amendment Summary - Section 5.2 Exclusion Criteria / Section 8.3.3.8

data.text: Added the word 'in a blinded fashion' for all dose adjustments managed through IWRS. Clarification.

data.text: Updated the section title from 'Meals and Dietary Restrictions' to 'Meals and Nutrition'. Added more detailed guidance on monitoring and managing nutritional and hydration status throughout the study.

data.description: Original Protocol for Study J1I-MC-GZBY - A Phase 3, Randomized, Multicenter, Double-Blind Study to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Retatrutide Once Weekly Compared with Placebo in Adult Participants with Type 2 Diabetes and Inadequate Glycemic Control with Diet and Exercise Alone (TRANSCEND-T2D-1)

Protocol Amendment (a) for Study J1I-MC-GZBY. Changes include: addition of new AESI of malnutrition and inadequate fluid intake; updated AESI title for ketoacidosis; more detailed guidance on nutritional intake and hydration monitoring; updated dose modification criteria; inclusion of adjudication of urgent visit for heart failure. Document ID: VV-CLIN-133434. IND: 145825. Electronically Signed and Approved by Lilly on 17 Feb 2025 GMT.
